items.prompt: For n=3 fair six-sided dice, which returned line has the required exact reduced form?

options.why: This is the same real number but the contract requests an integer or exact fraction, not a decimal.
The fraction is equivalent but not reduced.
7*n is 21, which is odd, so the reduced denominator remains 2.
